# `rate_limited`

The caller is over a request budget.

| Status | Title | `type` |
|---|---|---|
| `429` | Rate limited | `https://substrat.net/errors/rate-limited` |

## What it means

Too many requests were counted against one budget within its window. `retryAfter` is the number of seconds to wait, also sent as the `Retry-After` header. The `RateLimit` header names the budget that refused.

## When it is returned

- A request to a hosted vertical over the per-credential or per-client-address budget. The router counts it before the vertical runs.
- A request to a node host that mounts `vertical-host`'s `rateLimit()`.

## What it carries

- `retryAfter`: Seconds to wait before retrying, the same value as the `Retry-After` header.

Like every problem, it may also carry `storeCode` and `storeBody`, and the [members every problem has](/errors/#the-body).

## What to do

Wait for `Retry-After` seconds, then retry. A client that polls should slow its loop instead of retrying at the same pace.
